COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No.1865 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
 Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel
for the applicant.
 Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned Assistant
Government Advocate for the State.
In the proceedings of Criminal Case
No.2172 of 2023, "State Vs. Mr. Amit Rekhi",
being a proceedings drawn by the applicant /
complainant under Section 498-A, 420 and
504 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry
Prohibition Act.
The same is presently pending
consideration before the Court of Chief
Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, District
Dehradun, which is being sought to be
decided expeditiously, owing to the fact, that
the proceedings have been kept lingering,
because the respondent is not residing in
India and presently, he is informed to be
engaged in Canada.
Without expressing any opinion on
merits of the matter, this C482 Application
would stand disposed of with the request to
the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,

Dehradun, to make all efforts to decide the
Criminal Case No.2172 of 2023, "State Vs. Mr.
Amit Rekhi", as expeditiously as possible, but
not later than six months from the date of
production of the certified copy of this order.
So far as relief no.2, for effecting service
of notice on the respondent through electronic
mode is concerned, the Court of Chief Judicial
Magistrate, upon an application to be filed by
the applicant, would permit the
applicant/complainant, to serve the
respondent no.2 through electronic mode and,
thereafter, proceed to decide the matter on its
own merits.
Subject to the aforesaid, the C482
Application would stand disposed of.
